title: The derivative-convolution real-rootedness conjecture
statement:
Let $p\in\mathbb{N}^*$ and let $P,Q\in\mathbb{R}[X]$ have degree $p$. **Derivative-convolution conjecture.** If $P$ and $Q$ are real-rooted, then

$$
\sum_{k=0}^p P^{(k)}Q^{(p-k)}
$$

is real-rooted as well. This is presented as an equivalent formulation of the semi-symmetric hyperbolicity conjecture, so it is connected to the concavity problem through the real-rootedness of associated polynomials. It remains open in the paper.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1712.10327

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2017).
source_name: Xavier Lachaume, “On the concavity of a sum of elementary symmetric polynomials”, arXiv:1712.10327 (2017).
